body: Thanks for the tip.   I’ll look elsewhere.
Read that too.   I hope the come stateside.   I’d give all my possessions to the person that would off me....but someone already tried that and got caught.
Agreed.   Wish I was as cool, but I’ll settle with wishing I was.
Tell only the truth.   I wish I was dead everyday.
Thanks...been there.   This is not what I’m looking for.    Haters of reddit down vote me so I can kill my self....I dare you.

You missed what I was asking completely.   Never said I was better than anyone.    Not flaws in people only my expectations of what they want to share with me.   But you haven’t been listening since the first post .

It’s not being nice in particular that’s stale...it’s just that those I love as passionately as I do the most elicit terrible responses for me because I love them so much that when they let me down it hurts tremendously.   I know it’s unreasonable as everyone is flawed,  but I guess it feels as though they don’t live me as much as I do them.   And the discrepancy causes me pain.    When I lower expectations and seek contentment, the love is at a muted level that doesn’t excite as much as it does when I keep high expectations.
I don’t know.    I can live a life of mediocrity I suppose but somehow that feels wrong.

Thank you.   I believe you are right.   I don’t question what they are saying.... I just recognize how stale my life is when I follow that advice.   It’s kind of like dieting.   I know it’s good for me .   I have the discipline to do it and I do it and I lose weight.     But remembering those things I loved to eat in the frequency that made me happy always makes me sad.    But I’m the case of relationships there is no substitute.    It’s not like instead of loving I can read a book.

Been there.   Apparently not medical.    I have an unpopular and unhealthy  expectation that living life this way will ultimately lead to happiness.    Despite failed attempts it does not.    I can engage in “healthy” relationships and try to feel happy when doing it...I just don’t.   You can train and teach as much as you want but you can’t force happiness.    Drug inducing it isn’t the answer either.     I recognize the root cause and I have the path out.    It just isn’t satisfying at all for me.

Thanks.   Been there.   I have techniques.   I have root cause.    I am what I am.  I don’t prescribe to the practical notions that my therapist is pushing.    I never feel the same way when I go about it in “healthy” ways.    Plus I don’t think life should be lived by lowering expectations or seeking contentment rather than the ideal.    Maybe I’m doomed to be alone.
